agent: PLL Consultant (reconciling late Ads Agent report)
text:
ADS AGENT REPORTED LATE — and it contradicts the failover answer I published for you. Here is the reconciliation.

Ads Agent's late finding: funnel NOT broken; contact form works; all 7 landing URLs return 200; 10 valid leads in 7 days (~1.4/day), 0 today; most PLL leads organic/direct, not ads. Its core claim: 4 of 5 campaigns (incl. ContractMfg) run Smart Bidding against Google's known-broken conversion signal, inflating CPC to $3.48. Proposed fix: revert all to Manual CPC, finish approved ContractMfg -> $25/day, add ad assets (73%+ impression share lost to rank). No changes made; bid-strategy change needs Sam's approval.

WHAT I INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED (live, just now):
- Landing pages: homepage 200, /pages/contact-us 200. /pages/contact returns 404. Both live forms POST to Shopify's standard /contact endpoint.
- CRITICAL: a 200 page load and a working POST target do NOT prove delivery. Shopify /contact forms deliver to whatever address is set in store settings — which is exactly the known open defect (Contact Us routing to the Manufacturing SEO Agency, not sam@prvtlabellabs.com). The Ads Agent presented reachability as proof of delivery. That evidence does not support that conclusion.
- Google Ads API is returning UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (v21 deprecated, requests blocked). I therefore CANNOT independently confirm the bid-strategy claim, the $3.48 CPC, or the 10-lead count. Treat all three as agent-reported, unverified.

CACHE STATUS: the callback contained no structured ads_intelligence object, so the Ads intelligence cache refresh is BLOCKED and was not updated. Screen answer published only.

RECOMMENDATION (unchanged in priority order):
1. Do not raise budget. Test the form end-to-end first: submit the homepage quote form and Contact Us, and confirm both land in sam@prvtlabellabs.com. That is a 5-minute test that settles the dispute.
2. Approve or decline the Manual CPC revert. If the conversion signal is genuinely broken, Smart Bidding is optimizing toward noise and Manual CPC is the right call — but I can't verify it until the Ads connection is reauthorized.
3. Reauthorize the Google Ads connection. Until then neither I nor anyone else can audit Ads Agent numbers, and search-terms/waste analysis stays unavailable.

ACCOUNTABILITY: this is Ads Agent failure #2 in seven days — it missed its 360-second guarantee window and reported only after I had already substituted. One more and its onboarding brief gets rewritten.
spoken_text: Sam, the Ads Agent finally reported, and it disagrees with what I told you. It says the funnel is fine and the real problem is bidding — four of five campaigns are using smart bidding against a conversion signal Google knows is broken, which is pushing your cost per click to about three dollars fifty. Here's my problem with that. Its proof that the form works is that the pages load. Pages loading doesn't mean a submission reaches your inbox, and your inbox routing is the known defect. So that conclusion isn't supported. I also could not check its numbers myself, because the Google Ads connection is returning a deprecated version error and is effectively down. So treat the bidding claim as unverified. My recommendation is unchanged: spend five minutes submitting your own form and confirm it lands in your inbox, and don't raise budget until it does. Also worth knowing, that's the second time in a week the Ads Agent missed its reporting window.
